key_findings.finding: ProductCD=C is a genuinely elevated-risk category: historical fraud rate 11.32%, ~3.2x the ~3.5% base rate. This is the strongest independent risk signal on this txn.
The closest confirmed-fraud case (#3429815) shares this txn's fingerprint: ProductCD=C, visa/debit, gmail.com, same card1=9500, small amount. This supports elevated risk.

However, the three washed-clean high-score false positives also share card1=9500 with large legitimate history; they differ mainly by ProductCD (W/S/H) and addr1=204. Resemblance to fraud is not conclusive.

card1=9500 is a well-established entity (12,392 prior txns) with a mature fraud rate of only 3.41% — essentially at base rate. This partially CONTRADICTS a high risk score; the card itself is not a fraud-heavy entity.

gang_score=0.341 is moderate, and fan-out (53 addr / 40 email / 65 device) is unremarkable given 12,392 txns. No strong gang signal. This tempers the GBDT p=0.5262, which appears driven mainly by ProductCD=C rather than entity-level fraud.
Transaction amount is very small ($28.04), limiting worst-case loss if it is fraud.

gang_association.rationale: gang_score 0.341 is only moderate, card1=9500 mature fraud rate is 3.41% (at base), and fan-out is proportionate to its 12,392-txn history. No evidence of coordinated batch abuse warranting escalation/freeze.

report.disposition_rationale: Middle-ground case. ProductCD=C and resemblance to a confirmed-fraud case raise concern, but the card entity itself is mature with base-rate fraud and no gang signal, contradicting the GBDT score. Amount is only $28, so decline risks a $25 misfire on a benign entity, while approve risks a small loss. $5 manual review is the cheapest option to disambiguate against the near-identical washed-clean false positives.
report.summary: Transaction 3508739 is a $28.04 ProductCD=C purchase (visa/debit, gmail, Windows desktop) on card1=9500. ProductCD=C carries ~3.2x base fraud rate and this txn's profile matches a confirmed-fraud case, which justifies caution. However, card1=9500 is a heavily-used, mature entity with only 3.41% mature fraud rate and a moderate gang_score (0.341), and several near-identical high-score cases on this same card were manually cleared. The GBDT p=0.5262 appears largely driven by the ProductCD=C category rather than genuine entity-level fraud — a partial conflict with my entity evidence. Given the tiny amount and ambiguous signals, I recommend HOLD for $5 manual review rather than an outright decline. No gang escalation warranted.
